originalMetadata.title: How to actually unfu** your Attention Span
originalMetadata.description:
Your attention span isn’t broken(prolly), it’s just bored. In this video, you’ll learn how to fix your focus in 70(or 71) seconds without deleting TikTok or forcing a dopamine detox. Instead, discover the simple strategy that Ed Sheeran used to turn his stutter into stage confidence, and how you can use it to rebuild your attention span and unlock [deep] focus.
